text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, developers must consider responsive design, which means the app works well on different screen sizes. Another important choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on several. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to load quickly and run smoothly. If an app is slow or crashes often, people will delete it. So developers must test carefully before releasing their app to the public.
